decisions.reason: After two years there is still no clear negative signal, and the handle family costs little to keep within the modular range, so the option stays open while demand becomes clearer.
The mitred family shares production and finishing with the core range, so carrying it costs little, though weak visibility so far slightly raises the risk of withdrawal.
This single multifunctional handle fits the firm's accessibility strategy and has not revealed low value, so keeping it to learn more is still cheap.
The award-winning collection with its own dedicated page has shown early value that justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The finish uses existing finishing capability at minimal cost and adds variety across product families, so there is little reason to give up the option.
